meta.description: Kickoff 56, the phase sweep on Kickoff 55's three chains, fixed by the rule: 6-7-8, 42-43-44 and 31-18-11 (L1-M-L3). A known phase phi in {0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300} degrees, one rz(phi) on M right after its first H. Per chain and phi: W-no(phi), the wait test without refocusing; R1(phi), the active-neighbour Ramsey (manacitra.wait.build_wait_ramsey, its default); R0(phi), the idle-neighbour Ramsey (neighbours="idle"). Per chain, once: W-ref (XY4), Z and the pulse-cost circuit (H on M, the four XY4 pulses back to back with no wait, H, measure). 63 circuits, each 2 copies of 3000 shots, 126 positions in one random order; the sampler's own dynamical decoupling and twirling off, as IBM recorded them.

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

import hw_54 as K54  # noqa: E402  Kickoff 54's pulse-cost builder, unchanged

              "tabulate_history.py": "4d5ff8ec85bf6381a16c5bdd0da933b986aba0df60f24243efe68e2cb8b0ce9d",
              "scan_handback.py": "27e8066b243904bf0327f4288b7231b21a062f4f28888892443f1f9c1376e208"}
K55_DIR = HERE.parent / "hardware-55"
CHAINS = [[6, 7, 8], [42, 43, 44], [31, 18, 11]]

def sha(p):

now = K50.now


def log(msg):

    with (HERE / "run.log").open("a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def in_window(t=None):
    """True if t lies inside the window recorded in window-56.json (k56-rule.md, 'When')."""
    t = t or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    w = json.loads((HERE / "window-56.json").read_text())["window"]
    if not w.get("applies"):
        return False
    a = datetime.fromisoformat(w["from_utc"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    b = datetime.fromisoformat(w["to_utc"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return a <= t <= b


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the calibration record
def record_stamp(backend, kind, job_status="", refresh=True):
    """Read the backend's properties, save the snapshot if its stamp is new, compare it by value with the previous one
    (history 01's compare and other_changes), and append a row to stamps-56.csv."""
    STAMPS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p = backend.properties(refresh=refresh)
    s = p.last_update_date.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    name = f"snapshot-{s.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}.json"
    path = STAMPS / name
    rows_p = HERE / "stamps-56.csv"
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(rows_p.open())) if rows_p.exists() else []
    seen = [r["snapshot"] for r in rows]
    new = name not in seen
    row = {"utc": now(), "kind": kind, "stamp_utc": s.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), "stamp_raw": str(p.last_update_date),
           "new_stamp": new, "job_status": job_status, "snapshot": name}
    if not path.exists():
        path.write_text(json.dumps(p.to_dict(), default=str, indent=1) + "\n")
    if new and seen:
        prev = STAMPS / seen[-1]
        c = TH.compare(TH.load(prev), TH.load(path))
        o = TH.other_changes(prev, path)
        row.update({"q_T1": c["q_T1"], "q_T2": c["q_T2"], "q_readout_error": c["q_readout_error"], "g1_any": c["g1_any"],
                    "cz_error": c["cz_error"], "cz_length": c["cz_length"], "other_values_changed": o["other_values_changed"],
                    "any_value_changed": o["any_value_changed"]})
    with rows_p.open("a", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=STAMP_FIELDS)
        if not rows:
            w.writeheader()
        w.writerow(row)
    return row


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the chains' published values
def published(backend):
    """The chains' published errors, T1 and T2 at build time, beside Kickoff 55's (chains-55.json, at its draw)."""
    props, t = backend.properties(), backend.target
    cz = {tuple(int(x) for x in k) for k in t["cz"].keys() if k is not None}

    def safe(fn, *a):
        try:
            v = fn(*a)
            return None if v is None else float(v)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def edge_err(a, b):
        errs = [safe(props.gate_error, "cz", [x, y]) for x, y in ((a, b), (b, a)) if (x, y) in cz]
        return None if (not errs or any(e is None for e in errs)) else max(errs)

    def operational(q):
        try:
            return bool(props.is_qubit_operational(q))
        except Exception:
            return False

    k55 = {tuple(d["chain"]): d for d in json.loads((K55_DIR / "chains-55.json").read_text())["drawn"]}
    out = []
    for c in CHAINS:
        l1, m, l3 = c
        now_ = {"readout_error": {str(q): safe(props.readout_error, q) for q in c},
                "cz_error": {f"{l1}-{m}": edge_err(l1, m), f"{m}-{l3}": edge_err(m, l3)},
                "T1_us": {str(q): (safe(props.t1, q) or 0) * 1e6 for q in c}, "T2_us": {str(q): (safe(props.t2, q) or 0) * 1e6 for q in c},
                "operational": {str(q): operational(q) for q in c}}
        was = k55.get(tuple(c), {})
        out.append({"chain": c, "M": m, "at_build": now_,
                    "kickoff_55_at_draw": {k: was.get(k) for k in ("readout_error", "cz_error", "T1_us", "T2_us", "operational")}})
    return {"backend": backend.name, "calibration_stamp": str(props.last_update_date), "utc": now(),
            "kickoff_55_stamp_at_draw": json.loads((K55_DIR / "chains-55.json").read_text())["calibration_stamp"],
            "chains": out, "note": "fixed by k56-rule.md (Kickoff 55's chains), not drawn"}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the circuits
def made(qc, chain, backend, name):
    ins, isa = K51._made(qc, chain, backend)
    return K50.rebuild(isa, ins, name)


def build_chain(chain, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    no0 = W.build_wait_test(chain, False, backend)
    tl0 = K50.timed(K50.schedule(no0, backend, chain)[0], t, dt, chain)
    T = K50.window(tl0, M)["T_dt"]
    c = {}
    for phi in PHIS:
        c[("W-no", phi)] = W.build_wait_test(chain, False, backend, phase=math.radians(phi))
        c[("R1", phi)] = W.build_wait_ramsey(chain, backend, phase=math.radians(phi))
        c[("R0", phi)] = W.build_wait_ramsey(chain, backend, neighbours="idle", phase=math.radians(phi))
    c[("W-ref", 0)] = W.build_wait_test(chain, True, backend)
    c[("Z", 0)] = made(K50.logical("Z", T), chain, backend, f"Z-{M}")
    c[("XY4", 0)] = made(K54.logical_xy4(), chain, backend, f"XY4-{M}")
    return c, {"T_M": K50.window(tl0, M), "tl_no": tl0, "T": T}


def part_of(k):
    return "W" if k[0].startswith("W") else ("B" if k[0] == "XY4" else "R")


def m_clbit_of(k):
    return 0 if k[0] == "R0" else M_CLBIT


def checks(chain, circ, info, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    T = info["T"]
    rec, tls, exact = {}, {}, {}
    for (k, phi), c in circ.items():
        lay = [M] if k == "R0" else chain
        ins, _ = K50.schedule(c, backend, lay)
        tl = K50.timed(ins, t, dt, lay)
        tls[(k, phi)] = tl
        ops = {a: int(b) for a, b in c.count_ops().items()}
        init = list(c.layout.initial_index_layout(filter_ancillas=True))
        p = W.exact_distribution(c)
        bit = lambda key, i: key[::-1][i] == "1"
        r = {"count_ops": ops, "no_swap": ops.get("swap", 0) == 0, "layout_as_named": init == lay,
             "non_delay_ops_only_on_chain": {c.find_bit(q).index for i in c.data if i.operation.name != "delay" for q in i.qubits} <= set(lay)}
        seq = K51.m_sequence(c, M)
        names = [n for n, _ in seq]
        if k.startswith("W"):
            r["exact_F"] = W.fidelity(p, ideal)
            r["exact_F_expected"] = math.cos(math.radians(phi) / 2) ** 2
            r["exact_F_as_expected"] = abs(r["exact_F"] - r["exact_F_expected"]) < 1e-6
            r["structure_5cz_6meas_3reset"] = ops.get("cz") == 5 and ops.get("measure") == 6 and ops.get("reset") == 3
            r["both_couplers_used"] = {tuple(sorted(c.find_bit(q).index for q in i.qubits)) for i in c.data if i.operation.name == "cz"} == {tuple(sorted((L1, M))), tuple(sorted((M, L3)))}
            if k == "W-ref":
                r["pulses_on_M"] = K50.x_on(c, M) > K50.x_on(circ[("W-no", 0)], M)
            exact[(k, phi)] = r["exact_F"]
        else:
            mb = m_clbit_of((k, phi))
            r["exact_P1_M"] = sum(v for key, v in p.items() if bit(key, mb))
            r["exact_P1_expected"] = {"XY4": 0.0, "Z": 0.0}.get(k, math.sin(math.radians(phi) / 2) ** 2)
            r["exact_P1_as_expected"] = abs(r["exact_P1_M"] - r["exact_P1_expected"]) < 1e-9
            exact[(k, phi)] = r["exact_P1_M"]
            if k != "XY4":
                w = K50.window(tl, M)
                r["M_window"] = w
                if k == "Z":
                    r["window_ok"] = w["T_dt"] == 0
                elif k == "R0":
                    r["window_ok"] = w["T_dt"] == W.even_wait(T, getattr(t, "granularity", 1) or 1)
                    r["window_beside_T_M"] = {"idle_even_T_M_dt": w["T_dt"], "T_M_dt": T}
                else:
                    r["window_ok"] = w["T_dt"] == T
        if k in ("W-no", "R0", "R1"):
            i = names.index("sx")
            r["M_first_H_then_next"] = seq[i - 1:i + 3]
            if phi:
                r["phase_one_rz_after_first_H"] = seq[i - 1] == ("rz", 90.0) and seq[i + 1] == ("rz", 90.0) and seq[i + 2] == ("rz", float(phi)) and names.count("rz") == 5
            else:
                r["phase_none_at_0"] = names.count("rz") == 4
        if k == "W-no":
            j0, j1 = names.index("sx"), len(names) - 1 - names[::-1].index("sx")
            between = names[j0 + 1:j1]
            core = between[1:-1]
            if phi:
                core = core[1:] if core[:1] == ["rz"] else ["?"]
            r["M_ops_between_H"] = between
            r["check_cz_barrier_and_phase_only"] = set(core) <= {"cz", "barrier"} and core.count("cz") == 5
        rec[f"{k}|{phi}"] = r
    tab = {str(q): {"W-no unedited": K50.events(info["tl_no"], q),
                    **{f"{k}|{phi}": K50.events(tls[(k, phi)], q) for k in ("W-no", "R1") for phi in PHIS}} for q in (L1, L3)}
    same = all(v == tab[str(q)]["W-no unedited"] for q in (L1, L3) for v in tab[str(q)].values())
    rec["_neighbours"] = {"measure_reset_times": tab, "R1_and_W_no_same_as_W_no_unedited": same}
    # check 6: Kickoff 52's fit on the exact values (W-no's F, R0's and R1's P(1) minus Z's)
    yW = np.array([exact[("W-no", p)] for p in PHIS])
    yR = {c_: np.array([exact[(c_, p)] - exact[("Z", 0)] for p in PHIS]) for c_ in ("R0", "R1")}
    th = {"W": float(A52.theta_W(yW)), "R0": float(A52.theta_R(yR["R0"])), "R1": float(A52.theta_R(yR["R1"]))}
    L = float(A52.wrap(th["W"] - th["R1"]))
    rec["_exact_fit"] = {"theta_deg": th, "L_deg": L, "pass": all(abs(v) < 1e-6 for v in th.values()) and abs(L) < 1e-6}
    flat = [v for kk, r in rec.items() if not kk.startswith("_") for v in r.values() if isinstance(v, bool)]
    return rec, all(flat) and same and rec["_exact_fit"]["pass"]


def build(backend):
    circ, recs, infos, ok = {}, {}, {}, True
    for chain in CHAINS:
        name = str(chain[1])
        c, info = build_chain(chain, backend)
        r, good = checks(chain, c, info, backend)
        ok = ok and good
        circ[name], recs[name], infos[name] = c, r, {"T_M": info["T_M"], "chain": chain}
    return circ, recs, infos, ok


def assemble(circ, seed=SEEDS["order"]):
    items = [(str(ch[1]), ch, k, cp) for ch in CHAINS for k in circ[str(ch[1])] for cp in range(1, COPIES + 1)]
    perm = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(len(items))
    circs, labels, shots = [], [], []
    for i in perm:
        n, chain, k, cp = items[i]
        labels.append({"M": int(n), "chain": chain, "circuit": k[0], "phi_deg": k[1], "copy": cp, "m_clbit": m_clbit_of(k), "part": part_of(k),
                       "built_by": "package" if k[0] in ("W-no", "W-ref", "R0", "R1") else "outside the package (hw_50 Z; hw_54 XY4)"})
        circs.append(circ[n][k])
        shots.append(SHOTS)
    return circs, labels, shots
